meta.subject: English grammar
meta.goal: Students can distinguish the present perfect from the simple past and choose the correct form from context.

objectives.text: Explain whether a sentence connects a past event to the present.
Choose present perfect or simple past from time expressions and intended meaning.

concepts.label: present perfect vs simple past choice

misconceptions.text: Students may think have + past participle always means a completed past event.

slides.title: 同じ『行った』でも、英語では今とのつながりで形が変わる

notes.teacherPrompt: Which sentence fits a speaker who is still talking about the present situation?

slides.title: yesterday は『終わった過去』、for five years は『今まで続く時間』を示す

notes.explanation: Have students notice the time expression before naming the grammar rule.

slides.title: 現在完了は『過去の出来事』ではなく『現在から見た過去』を表す

notes.explanation: Introduce have + past participle only after the meaning contrast is established.
notes.teacherPrompt: Where is the speaker's viewpoint: only in the past, or at the present?

slides.title: 時間表現→今とのつながり→時制、の順に判断すると迷わない

notes.explanation: Model one complete decision from clue to answer.
notes.teacherPrompt: What clue should we read first?

slides.title: まず手がかりだけ探す：答えより先に時間表現を見つける

notes.teacherPrompt: Do not ask for the tense first. Ask students to point to the clue.
notes.expectedAnswer: Students identify the time expression, then choose the tense.
notes.clickOrder: question → clue prompt → hint → answer → reason

slides.title: 説明なしで選べるか：現在完了か過去形かを1問で確認する

notes.teacherPrompt: Give silent thinking time before taking answers.
notes.expectedAnswer: Student chooses and explains present connection.

slides.title: 最後は自力で判断：手がかりと意味を根拠に時制を選ぶ

notes.teacherPrompt: Ask for the reason, not only the answer.
notes.expectedAnswer: Correct tense plus a clue-based explanation.
